material.body: Verified against /tmp/g688-lni/table/ability.ini (6.88g LNI extract, hy3d): CLINKZ_STRAFE cooldown 40/35/30/25 (A030), CLINKZ_DEATH_PACT cooldown 45/35/25 (A04Q). Not confirmed in 6.88g, do not port without a source: CLINKZ_WIND_WALK 20/19/18/17, SLARK_POUNCE_DAMAGE, ZUUS_STATIC_FIELD_DAMAGE_PCT, ZUUS_THUNDERGODS_WRATH_BASE_DAMAGE. Hero kits are absent from scenarios/moba/abilities.osd, so port as new ability rows.
